directions.name: FixDecide
directions.description: AI 修复方案的决策辅助工具，对比多种修复策略并让开发者做出最终判断
directions.description_en: A decision-support tool for AI-generated bug fixes that presents multiple repair strategies side-by-side so developers make the final call.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者和小型技术团队
directions.target_user_en: Independent developers and small engineering teams
core_features: AI 发现代码问题后生成 3 种不同修复方案
每个方案附带风险等级、影响范围说明
开发者一键批准/拒绝/编辑，决策记录留档
core_features_en: AI detects code issues and generates 3 alternative fix strategies
Each plan includes risk level and impact scope analysis
One-click approve/reject/edit with decision audit trail
directions.why_now: DEV Community 近期热议'AI 能找到故障，但谁来决定修复方案'，反映出开发者对 AI 盲目应用修复的普遍焦虑。社区讨论显示独立开发者越来越在意 AI 工具在'判断环节'的介入边界，而非单纯追求自动化。FixDecide 正好填补这个空白——把 AI 定位为建议者而非决策者，符合当前'可控 AI'趋势。
directions.why_now_en: DEV Community recently discussed 'AI can find the failure, but who decides what the fix should be?', reflecting developer anxiety about blind AI-driven fixes. Independent developers increasingly care about AI's role in judgment calls rather than pure automation. FixDecide fills this gap by positioning AI as advisor, not decider — aligning with the current 'controllable AI' trend.
directions.monetization: Freemium：每月 50 次免费扫描，高级版 ¥99/月（无限扫描 + 团队共享决策库）
directions.monetization_en: Freemium: 50 free scans/month, Pro at ¥99/month (unlimited scans + shared team decision library)
directions.source_article: AI Can Find the Failure. Who Decides What the Fix Should Be?

directions.name: Cursor插件地图
directions.description: Cursor/MCP 插件的发现与对比平台，帮助开发者快速找到适合自己工作流的插件组合
directions.description_en: A discovery and comparison platform for Cursor plugins and MCP tools, helping developers find the right plugin combinations for their workflow.
directions.target_user: 使用 Cursor 的独立开发者和一人公司技术负责人
directions.target_user_en: Independent developers and solo tech leads using Cursor
core_features: 按功能分类浏览所有公开 Cursor 插件和 MCP 工具
插件冲突检测：同一目标场景的插件无法同时生效时给出提示
用户自定义工作流模板分享（如'DevOps 自动化模板'、'全栈开发模板'）
core_features_en: Browse all public Cursor plugins and MCP tools by category
Conflict detection: alerts when plugins targeting the same workflow can't coexist
directions.why_now: GitHub Trending 上 cursor/plugins 热度持续走高，但生态仍处于早期混乱阶段——大量插件缺乏统一入口和对比信息，开发者难以判断哪些 MCP 工具真正值得安装。社区高频讨论集中在'装了十几个 Cursor 插件但互相冲突'和'MCP 工具太多不知道选哪个'。此时做一个聚合发现平台，正好卡位这个信息不对称窗口期。
directions.why_now_en: cursor/plugins on GitHub Trending continues to climb, but the ecosystem is still early and chaotic — no unified directory or comparison for Cursor plugins and MCP tools. High-frequency community discussions focus on 'installed dozen of conflicting plugins' and 'too many MCP tools, don't know which to pick.' Building an aggregation platform now captures this information asymmetry window.
directions.monetization: 插件作者付费上架（¥199/个首发推广），Pro 用户解锁高级对比和推荐功能（¥49/月）
directions.monetization_en: Plugin authors pay for featured listing (¥199 per launch promotion), Pro users unlock advanced comparisons and recommendations (¥49/month)
